learned: 2026-10-05, agent pass: no shop or product page; the COA page is the only product index. 4 pre-roll strains in two formats (single 0.75g, 5-pack minis) and 3 whole-flower strains, each an accordion of lot lines. Check: 9 of the 9 products NY stores sell are on the site.
notes: One item per lot line, so a strain's two pre-roll formats come out separately. The line does not repeat the strain (the accordion header does, which a line cannot reach), so the strain is read from the lot code: SG Silly Goofy, LB Lobotomy, PNC P.N.C. (the header's 'POST NUT CLARITY (P.N.C.)'; stores write PNC), SCK Sasha Colby Kush ('lot #SG-FPR25003', 'lot #CR-HF-5pk-SG-1'). Early lots have bare numbers ('lot #010010001', '#FPR24003'); every product also has coded lots, so those are skipped. A new strain code falls through to unparsed on purpose.
Flower lines name the strain: 'He He / Ha Ha lot #HH-FFA26004', 'Hehe Haha Lot# CR-HF-FL-HH-1'.

Sizes: the singles say 0.75g. The 5-packs and the flower state no weight; NY stores sell the 5-pack minis as 5 x 0.5g ('Silly Goofy | Pre-Rolls | 5 x .5g | 5pk') and the flower as 3.5g ('Flamer - Revelation - 3.5g'), so those are constants.
